name: norminv
expr: x_default = norminv(ps); x_mu5 = norminv(ps, 5, 1); x_sig2 = norminv(ps, 0, 2); x_both = norminv(ps, 5, 2); x_p0 = norminv(0); x_p1 = norminv(1); x_pneg = norminv(-0.1); x_pover = norminv(1.5); x_sigbad = norminv(0.5, 0, 0); x_signeg = norminv(0.5, 0, -1);
comment: Sig: x = norminv(p[, mu, sigma]). Inverse Normal CDF: x = mu + sigma*Φ⁻¹(p). Defaults mu=0, sigma=1. Edges: p=0 => -Inf; p=1 => +Inf; p outside [0,1] => NaN; sigma<=0 => NaN. Tol 1e-9 -- erfcinv algorithm differs ~1e-12 absolute from MATLAB.
